lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical lines visible; spacing is widest in the mid-torso region and becomes progressively narrower toward the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 6th and 7th lines (counting anterior to posterior) where they appear to merge near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated line segments are visible on the anterior shoulder region that terminate before reaching the mid-lateral point of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 distinct high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior flank, immediately superior to the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the lower posterior haunch align on a near-horizontal axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, emerging at approximately 55 degrees from the skull base, curving laterally outward before turning inward toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 12-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-density cluster of small, dark, high-contrast circular objects (likely dipterans) is visible on the ocular and nasal regions of the face.
other_distinctive_markers: White chevron mark located between the eyes; prominent white transverse bands visible on the lower limbs above the fetlock; distinct white spots on the lower muzzle.
